title: Construction of 2.4 km Paved Rural Link Road connecting Baragaon to NH-31
description: Bituminous surfacing, drainage culverts, and village approach road constructed under MPLADS rural connectivity guidelines.
locationDetails: Baragaon Gram Panchayat, Pindra Tehsil, Varanasi
sourceDocument: District Collectorate Sanction File No. DPO/MPLAD/2023-24/418

findings.title: Expenditure Exceeds Sanctioned Amount
findings.explanation: The recorded project expenditure of ₹61,50,000 exceeds the formally sanctioned budget of ₹42,00,000 by ₹19,50,000 (46.4% excess).
findings.evidence: Discrepancy detected in fiscal ledger: Sanctioned = 4200000, Recorded Expenditure = 6150000. Official MPLADS guidelines prohibit unapproved expenditure exceeding sanction limits without revised administrative sanction.
findings.sourceReference: District Collectorate Sanction File No. DPO/MPLAD/2023-24/418
findings.dataLimitations: Subject to whether supplementary administrative sanctions or cost escalations were issued under a separate file number.
findings.recommendedAction: Verify whether a revised sanction order exists with the District Nodal Authority. Request contractor interim billing vouchers and technical sanction records.

findings.title: Recorded Expenditure Exceeds Total Released Funds
findings.explanation: Implementing agency reports having spent ₹61,50,000, but only ₹42,00,000 has been formally released from the nodal account.
findings.evidence: Physical expenditure exceeds cash release: 6150000 > 4200000. Indicates either agency bridge-financing or erroneous claim submissions.
findings.dataLimitations: Agency may have temporarily utilized department revolving funds pending reimbursement.
findings.recommendedAction: Inspect Utilization Certificates (UC) submitted by the implementing agency to verify fund sourcing.

findings.title: Potential Duplicate or Overlapping Project Detected
findings.explanation: This project exhibits near-identical scope, category (Rural Roads), and location details with another registered project record (ID: MPLAD-2024-UP-0419 - "Construction of 2.4 km Paved Rural Link Road connecting Baragaon to NH-31 (Segment II)").

comparedValues.valueA: Construction of 2.4 km Paved Rural Link Road connecting Baragaon to NH-31 (₹42,00,000)
comparedValues.valueB: Construction of 2.4 km Paved Rural Link Road connecting Baragaon to NH-31 (Segment II) (₹39,00,000)

findings.evidence: High lexical and geographic overlap: District: Varanasi, Category: Rural Roads, Titles matching. MPLADS guidelines forbid sanctioning double funding for identical civil assets.
findings.dataLimitations: Could represent Phase-II of an identical multi-stage infrastructure project if sanctioned as separate work packages.
findings.recommendedAction: Examine detailed work estimates and GIS asset coordinates to confirm physical asset exclusivity.
